_purpose: T091 (SpecKit-004 'fast-dev-cycles', User Story 3) golden case for closure/reopen_rate.py (plan.md T-D06, tasks.md T100). A hand-computed window with a clean, unambiguous per-type population: every closed item genuinely has a closure event (Fixed/Implemented/Completed) whose on_date falls inside the window, and the one reopened item is a genuine member of that same closed-in-window population (its own Reopened event ALSO falls inside the window) -- this is the healthy case CT-006's 'both counted from the same population' text describes, contrasted with golden_bad_mismatched_populations (a Reopened event on an item with NO closure event anywhere in its history) and negative_control_retroactive (a closure event that must be EXCLUDED, not merely a boundary case).
_note: None of these atm_id values exist in the real docs/workable_items.db (a B-/T-/F- prefix distinct from the real ATM-/SPK- schemes; verified 2026-09-29 by control needle #1 in test_reopen_rate_red.sh against the live DB before this fixture's numbers are trusted).

item_history._note: Closed BEFORE the window (Fixed 2026-06-20 < window.from 2026-07-01) -- MUST NOT be counted in closed_in_window for any type. Window-start boundary exercise.

Closed INSIDE the window (counts toward Bug closed_in_window) but its Reopened event falls AFTER window.to (2026-08-05 > 2026-07-31) -- MUST NOT be counted toward reopened_in_window. Window-end boundary exercise for the numerator specifically (distinct from B-005's denominator boundary exercise).

Bug.closed_in_window_reasoning: B-005 excluded: its Fixed on_date=2026-06-20 is BEFORE window.from=2026-07-01. All other 5 Bug items have a closure event (Fixed) with on_date in [2026-07-01, 2026-07-31].
Bug.reopened_in_window_reasoning: Of the 5 closed-in-window Bug items, only B-001 has a Reopened event whose on_date (2026-07-10) is ALSO inside the window. B-006's own Reopened event exists but its on_date=2026-08-05 is AFTER window.to=2026-07-31, so B-006 does not count toward the numerator even though it is a member of the denominator population.

_hand_computation.excluded_retroactive_reasoning: No item_history row pair in this fixture has an Opened->closure created_at gap in [0, 60) seconds; every gap is measured in days. This fixture deliberately keeps the retroactive-registration mechanic OUT of scope so it tests the matched-population happy path in isolation -- see the sibling fixture negative_control_retroactive/tracker_export.json for that mechanic.
